_meta.purpose: Seed data for the equipment catalog: 71 rackets, 46 strings. Shoes / shuttles / bags / grips are not sourced yet — the Gear register parks a category until the catalog can answer for it, so adding rows here is the only step needed to un-park one.
_meta.schema: Each entry matches CatalogItem in lib/types.ts. `id` is stable and deterministic so re-runs are idempotent. `skillRange` follows the ACE stage scale [1-6] from lib/skills-data.ts.
_meta.sources: Each item carries non-affiliate retailer links (Yumo, RacquetGuys, BadmintonHQ) for now. Per Decision D in the plan, affiliateTag fields ship null in Slice-0; the field exists so flipping monetization on later is schema-free.
_meta.curation: ~17 popular models each from Yonex, Victor and Li-Ning. Hand-picked from public best-sellers + recreational-player community recommendations — not authoritative, will be revised once admin can edit the catalog (Track 2).
